notes.native: لا أستطيع أن أفهم كيف تعمل هذه الآلة.
references: I can't figure out how this machine works.

notes.native: نحتاج إلى أن نتوصل إلى خطة أفضل.
references: We need to figure out a better plan.
I ran into my old teacher at the supermarket.
We ran into some problems with the car.
I can't put up with this noise anymore.
She puts up with a lot at work.
I'm looking forward to seeing you again.
We look forward to hearing from you.
Don't give up, you're almost there.

notes.native: أقلع أخيرًا عن التدخين العام الماضي.
references: He finally gave up smoking last year.

notes.native: هل يمكنك أن تأخذني من المطار؟
references: Can you pick me up from the airport?

notes.native: تعلمت القليل من الإسبانية خلال رحلتي.
references: I picked up a little Spanish on my trip.

notes.native: هل يمكنك خفض صوت الموسيقى، من فضلك؟
references: Could you turn down the music, please?
She turned down the job offer.

notes.native: نحتاج إلى أن نأتي بفكرة جديدة.
references: We need to come up with a new idea.
Who came up with this name?
I just found out that the store is closed.
Let me find out what time the train leaves.
I get along well with my neighbors.
Do you get along with your brother?

notes.native: هل يمكنك الاعتناء بكلبي في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع هذه؟
references: Could you look after my dog this weekend?
She looks after her grandmother every day.
I'll look up the word in the dictionary.

notes.native: دعني أبحث عن العنوان في هاتفي.
references: Let me look up the address on my phone.

notes.native: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في إعداد حاسوبي المحمول الجديد؟
references: Can you help me set up my new laptop?
They set up their own company last year.

notes.native: من فضلك اخلع حذاءك قبل أن تدخل.
references: Please take off your shoes before you come in.
Our plane takes off at nine in the morning.
He didn't show up for the meeting.

notes.native: إنها تأتي دائمًا متأخرة إلى الحصة.
references: She always shows up late to class.
They called off the game because of the rain.
We had to call off the wedding.
Sorry for interrupting, please carry on.
We carried on walking until it got dark.

notes.native: يجب أن نسجل وصولنا في الفندق قبل السادسة.
references: We need to check in at the hotel before six.

notes.native: يمكنك تسجيل الوصول عبر الإنترنت قبل رحلتك بيوم.
references: You can check in online the day before your flight.

notes.native: يجب أن تجرب ذلك المطعم الجديد.
references: You should check out that new restaurant.
What time do we have to check out of the hotel?

notes.native: من فضلك املأ هذه الاستمارة ووقّعها.
references: Please fill out this form and sign it.
I filled out the application last night.

notes.native: استغرقني الأمر أسابيع لأتعافى من الإنفلونزا.
references: It took me weeks to get over the flu.
He still hasn't gotten over the breakup.
What's going on here?
Please go on, I'm listening.

notes.native: هل تريد أن نقضي بعض الوقت معًا في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟
references: Do you want to hang out this weekend?

notes.native: كنا نقضي الوقت في الحديقة بعد المدرسة.
references: We used to hang out at the park after school.
Hold on a second, I'll be right back.
Hold on tight, the road is bumpy.
It's hard to keep up with all the news.
Slow down, I can't keep up with you.
I promise I won't let you down.

notes.native: شعرت بخيبة أمل كبيرة من نهاية الفيلم.
references: I felt really let down by the ending of the movie.

notes.native: قالت المديرة إنها ستنظر في المشكلة.
references: The manager said she would look into the problem.
We're looking into buying a new car.
He made up an excuse for being late.

notes.native: تشاجرا، لكنهما تصالحا في اليوم التالي.
references: They had a fight, but they made up the next day.
Thanks for pointing out my mistake.

notes.native: أشارت إلى أن المتجر مغلق أيام الأحد.
references: She pointed out that the store was closed on Sundays.
Stop putting off your homework.
We put off the trip until next summer.
We have run out of milk again.

notes.native: الوقت ينفد مني، يجب أن أسرع.
references: I'm running out of time, I need to hurry.
Don't worry, we'll sort it out tomorrow.

notes.native: يجب أن أرتب أوراقي قبل أن أسافر.
references: I need to sort out my papers before I travel.
Can you take care of the kids tonight?
I'll take care of the bill.

notes.native: لا ترمِ ذلك الصندوق، ما زلت أحتاجه.
references: Don't throw away that box, I still need it.
I threw away all my old clothes.
Could you turn up the volume a little?

notes.native: ظهرت مفاتيحي الضائعة في جيب سترتي.
references: My lost keys turned up in my jacket pocket.

notes.native: أتمرن في النادي الرياضي ثلاث مرات في الأسبوع.
references: I work out at the gym three times a week.

notes.native: لا تقلق، كل شيء سيكون على ما يرام.
references: Don't worry, everything will work out fine.
Our car broke down on the highway.
She broke down in tears when she heard the news.

notes.native: من فضلك لا تفتح موضوع السياسة على العشاء.
references: Please don't bring up politics at dinner.
She was brought up by her grandparents.
Calm down, it's not a big deal.
It took the baby an hour to calm down.
Let's get coffee and catch up soon.

notes.native: فاتني أسبوع من الدروس وعليّ أن ألحق بالباقين.
references: I missed a week of class and need to catch up.
Cheer up, tomorrow will be a better day.
This song always cheers me up.
Can you drop me off at the station?
I dropped off the package at the post office.

notes.native: انتهى بنا الأمر بالبقاء في البيت طوال عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.
references: We ended up staying at home all weekend.

notes.native: إذا واصلت فعل ذلك، فسينتهي بك الأمر مصابًا.
references: If you keep doing that, you'll end up hurt.
When did you get back from your trip?
I'll get back to you by the end of the week.
Let's go over the plan one more time.

notes.native: هل يمكنك مراجعة مقالي قبل أن أسلّمه؟
references: Could you go over my essay before I hand it in?

notes.native: نشأت في بلدة صغيرة على البحر.
references: I grew up in a small town by the sea.

notes.native: ماذا تريد أن تصبح عندما تكبر؟
references: What do you want to be when you grow up?

notes.native: كان الجو حارًا جدًا لدرجة أن رجلًا أُغمي عليه في القطار.
references: It was so hot that a man passed out on the train.

notes.native: وزّعت المعلمة أوراق الامتحان في التاسعة.
references: The teacher passed out the exams at nine.

notes.native: من فضلك خفّف السرعة، أنت تقود بسرعة كبيرة.
references: Please slow down, you're driving too fast.

notes.native: قال لي الطبيب أن أخفف من نشاطي وأرتاح.
references: The doctor told me to slow down and rest.

notes.native: هل يمكنني تجربة هذا الحذاء بمقاس أكبر؟
references: Can I try on these shoes in a bigger size?

notes.native: جربت خمسة فساتين قبل أن تختار واحدًا.
references: She tried on five dresses before she chose one.
I usually wake up at six thirty.

notes.native: من فضلك أيقظني قبل أن تغادر.
references: Please wake me up before you leave.

notes.native: لا أستطيع منع نفسي من القلق عندما تتأخر.
references: I can't help worrying when you show up late.

notes.native: لا أستطيع منع نفسي من الضحك عندما يختلق قصصًا سخيفة.
references: I can't help laughing when he makes up silly stories.
The more you work out, the more energy you'll have.

notes.native: كلما أجّلت واجباتي أكثر، زاد توتري.
references: The more I put off my homework, the more stressed I get.
If it hadn't been for you, I'd have given up.
If it hadn't been for my mom, I wouldn't have figured it out.
How dare you throw away my letters!

notes.native: كيف تجرؤ على ذكر حبيبي السابق على العشاء!
references: How dare you bring up my ex at dinner!

notes.native: ألغينا الرحلة، لكن هذا لا يعني أننا لا نستطيع الذهاب العام القادم.
references: We called off the trip, but this doesn't mean that we can't go next year.

notes.native: نشأت في باريس، لكن هذا لا يعني أنها تتحدث الفرنسية.
references: She grew up in Paris, but this doesn't mean that she speaks French.
How long does it take to get over a cold?
How long does it take to set up the new printer?

notes.native: قد يفاجئك هذا، لكنني أستيقظ في الخامسة كل يوم.
references: It may surprise you, but I wake up at five every day.

notes.native: قد يفاجئك هذا، لكن علاقتي جيدة مع مديري الآن.
references: It may surprise you, but I get along with my boss now.

notes.native: وصلنا إلى المطعم لنكتشف أنه مغلق.
references: We showed up at the restaurant only to find it was closed.

notes.native: بحثت عن العنوان لأكتشف أنه خاطئ.
references: I looked up the address only to find it was wrong.

notes.native: ما رأيك أن نلتقي في بيتي الليلة؟
references: How about we hang out at my place tonight?

notes.native: ما رأيك أن نجرب ذلك المقهى الجديد؟
references: How about checking out that new cafe?

notes.native: ماذا كنت ستفعل لو تعطلت سيارتك في الليل؟
references: What would you do if your car broke down at night?

notes.native: ماذا كنت ستفعل لو نفدت نقودك في الخارج؟
references: What would you do if you ran out of money abroad?
